environment.description: Apollo GraphQL server deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. No WAF attached. The ALB forwards all traffic directly to port 4000. JWT_SECRET is set via environment variable. No request throttling configured at any layer. Health checks on /health endpoint only.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with default listener rules, no WAF association
config.network: Public subnet, security group allows 443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0
config.jwt_secret: set via SSM Parameter Store, retrieved at boot
